home_lead: The open football database: championships, tables, matches and squads, kept by the people who follow them.
home_empty: No championships at this level yet.
about: GolAberto is a collaborative site kept by its readers: every table is what the recorded matches say, and any match can be corrected by someone who knows better.
catalog_empty: No championship by that name at this level.
no_phases: This championship has no stages recorded yet.

comment_placeholder: What did you make of the match?
comment_refused: Not posted. To comment, choose Sign in at the top of the page and use your passkey; a comment runs from 1 to 1000 characters. What you wrote is still here.
comments_none: No comments yet. Be the first to comment on this match.
edit_goal_choose: Choose a player from the line-ups
edit_refused: Could not save: only editors change matches, a played match has both sides' scores, and a goal needs a player from the line-ups. Your edits are still here.
edit_goal_hint: Pick the minute and the scorer, then choose Add goal under the side that scored.
chances_none: Chances are worked out while there are matches left to play.
chances_gone: This group does not exist or has been removed.
chances_method: Every match left is played 20,000 times, with the attack and defence each side has shown over recent seasons, the latest matches weighing most, and the advantage of playing at home. The chances move when a result is recorded. They are statistics, not odds to bet on.
reachable: Still possible, too rare to show
undecided: Not yet known whether it can still happen
game_importance_long: How much this result can still move each side's chances (home · away)
team_rating_long: The team's strength from 0 to 100: its chance of beating an average side, a draw counting a third
player_rating_long: The player's contribution per 90 minutes, from every minute he played
col_title_chance_long: Chance of the title, from the group's chances
home_selection: Up to 20 matches per section, chosen by team strength, match importance and proximity. Two-week window; Brasília time.
home_no_upcoming: No scheduled matches in this two-week window.
home_no_results: No results with a recorded kickoff in this two-week window.
